standard_prerequisites.name: Tensor functor with a complex
standard_prerequisites.statement: The functor from dg E-modules to the dg category of complexes of O-modules given by tensoring with K, sending E to K and preserving direct sums (the author's lemma lemma-tensor-with-complex, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the functor whose exactness is asserted and its properties are used throughout the proof (source lines 6157, 6165-6171).

standard_prerequisites.name: Admissible short exact sequence and its splitting
standard_prerequisites.statement: An admissible short exact sequence of dg modules splits as graded modules, so a graded left inverse to the surjection exists.
standard_prerequisites.use: The graded splitting s of the sequence is what produces the map between the tensored terms (source lines 6167-6171).

standard_prerequisites.name: Termwise split exact sequence of complexes
standard_prerequisites.statement: A short exact sequence of complexes that splits in each degree defines a distinguished triangle in the homotopy category.
standard_prerequisites.use: The conclusion of the proof is that the tensored sequence is termwise split exact, hence distinguished (source lines 6172-6180).

core_obligations: Pass to the homotopy categories: use the author's functoriality lemma to obtain a functor between the homotopy categories from the dg functor, and state that it remains to check distinguished triangles (source lines 6163-6166).

Transfer the splitting: from an admissible short exact sequence of dg E-modules choose a graded left inverse s of the surjection, and verify that s induces a map of graded O-modules between the tensored terms, so that the tensored sequence splits termwise (source lines 6167-6171).

Conclude exactness: observe that the resulting termwise split exact sequence of complexes defines a distinguished triangle in the homotopy category of complexes of O-modules, so the functor is exact (source lines 6172-6180).

proof_roadmap.step: Pass to homotopy categories and reduce to checking distinguished triangles.
Use the graded splitting to induce a map between the tensored terms.
See that the tensored sequence is termwise split exact, hence distinguished.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-tensor-with-complex-homotopy at source lines 6155-6160: the functor of the preceding lemma, tensoring a dg E-module with the complex K, defines an exact functor of triangulated categories from the homotopy category of dg E-modules to the homotopy category of complexes of O-modules. The proof at source lines 6162-6181 is a short but genuine exactness check. It first passes to the homotopy categories using the author's functoriality lemma, and then has to show that distinguished triangles go to distinguished triangles. Concretely, starting from an admissible short exact sequence of dg E-modules, it uses a graded splitting of the sequence to build a map between the tensored terms, checks that the resulting sequence of complexes is termwise split exact, and concludes that it is a distinguished triangle in the homotopy category of complexes of O-modules. The substance is the transfer of the splitting through the tensor product and the recognition that a termwise split exact sequence of complexes gives a distinguished triangle. The statement records only the conclusion. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
